drhp.expansion: Following the SASPL transfer of control, Lava Cast becomes the Company's principal continuing manufacturing platform. FY26 focus at Lava Cast was on equipment reliability, metallurgical and process controls, yield, rejection, energy intensity and machining productivity, with a stated intent to keep capacities duly exhausted through FY26-27. The export strategy is centred on a stage-gated pipeline (customer engagement, RFQ, plant audit, tooling and development, prototype validation, production-part approval, serial supply) rather than a specific commissioning project. In March 2026, SAL acquired the remaining equity interest in Lava Cast Private Limited (LCPL), making it a wholly owned subsidiary, and the Board approved a draft Scheme of Amalgamation to merge LCPL into SAL by absorption, subject to NCLT and other regulatory/stakeholder approvals.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- India remains one of the faster-growing major economies, supported by public infrastructure expenditure, domestic consumption, manufacturing investment and improving logistics connectivity, providing a constructive medium-term environment for commercial vehicles, tractors, construction equipment and auto components.
- The Indian automobile and auto-component industry benefits from a large domestic vehicle parc, replacement demand, infrastructure-led freight activity, OEM localisation and increasing formalisation of the aftermarket, though commercial-vehicle demand remains cyclical.
- Demand for fully machined cast components is linked to commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, tractors, construction equipment, off-highway applications and industrial equipment; global customers evaluate foundry partners on total delivered cost, metallurgical capability, machining depth, quality systems and traceability.
- For Lava Cast, the opportunity is to move progressively from concentrated demand toward a diversified portfolio of domestic and export customers, requiring sustained control over quality, yield, rejection, energy consumption, machining productivity and working capital.
- Export programs generally involve extended customer-development, tooling, validation and production-approval cycles, so export growth will be paced with quality, margin and cash-flow discipline.
- Commodity prices, energy costs, interest rates, currency movements and global trade actions remain important variables for manufacturing businesses.
- Lava Cast is building a disciplined order pipeline across customer engagement, RFQ, plant audit, tooling and development, prototype validation, production-part approval and serial supply.
- The continuing offtake relationship contemplated with SASPL provides a base operating relationship while Lava Cast develops a more diversified domestic and export customer portfolio.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: Following the SASPL transfer of control, Lava Cast becomes the Company's principal continuing manufacturing platform. FY26 focus at Lava Cast was on equipment reliability, metallurgical and process controls, yield, rejection, energy intensity and machining productivity, with a stated intent to keep capacities duly exhausted through FY26-27. The export strategy is centred on a stage-gated pipeline (customer engagement, RFQ, plant audit, tooling and development, prototype validation, production-part approval, serial supply) rather than a specific commissioning project. In March 2026, SAL acquired the remaining equity interest in Lava Cast Private Limited (LCPL), making it a wholly owned subsidiary, and the Board approved a draft Scheme of Amalgamation to merge LCPL into SAL by absorption, subject to NCLT and other regulatory/stakeholder approvals.

risks.body:
- Cyclical end markets and dependence on a limited number of customers can affect volumes, utilisation and bargaining power.
- The proposed merger of Lava Cast Private Limited into Setco Automotive Limited is subject to NCLT and other regulatory approvals and may take longer than planned.
- Breakdowns, maintenance gaps, low yield, rejection, metallurgical variation and capacity underutilisation can materially affect cost and delivery at Lava Cast.
- Scrap, alloy, power, fuel and consumable prices are volatile and may not be recovered immediately from customers.
- The Company's strategic focus has shifted materially following the transfer of control of SASPL to RSB Transmissions/Bain Capital; execution of the transition (accounting, legal, tax, stakeholder actions) carries residual risk while protecting the Company's contractual rights.
- The UK and North American subsidiaries' performance remained below their potential in FY26, requiring leaner cost structures, inventory and receivable discipline and portfolio rationalisation to restore profitability and cash generation.
- Export programmes for Lava Cast generally involve extended customer-development, tooling, validation and production-approval cycles, so converting the pipeline into serial supply carries execution and timing risk.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Shift strategic focus to Lava Cast as the principal continuing manufacturing platform, supported by UK and North American operations, following the SASPL transfer of control.
- Move the management agenda from restructuring to performance, emphasising sustainable profitability, customer diversification, export development, cash generation and capital efficiency.
- Diversify Lava Cast's domestic customer base and convert identified export programmes through a stage-gated customer qualification and commercial process.
- Progress the merger of Lava Cast Private Limited into Setco Automotive Limited to create a simpler listed operating structure, consolidate financial and operational oversight and reduce compliance duplication.
